_meta.page_mapping_check: Copy photos and facsimiles: PDF page = plate + 323 holds (694/695 VII, 696/697 VIII, 700/701 X; facsimiles are line drawings). Radiographs do NOT follow the given mapping: by printed captions, pl. CCCXLV-CCCXLVI (col. VII) = PDF 666-667, CCCXLVII-CCCXLVIII (VIII) = 668-669, CCCLI-CCCLII (X) = 672-673. PDF 668-671 hold cols VIII-IX and 674-675 col. XI, so pages 666-669 and 672-673 were used.
_meta.DJD_plates: LXI shows col. VII, LXIII col. VIII, LXVII col. X (contents match the columns). DJD photos are the 1950s segment photographs, much poorer than the copy photo; placed by local template matching to the Puech copy photo (scale about 0.8) checked visually.
_meta.extraction: pdfimages -png (embedded 150 dpi images); crops not sharpened or contrast-altered; 2x LANCZOS except where stated.

P41.words_on_facsimile: על פי יציאת המים של הכוז (Puech's line ends הכוז at the left; בא opens VII 15, which reads בא חפור ...). VII 13 above is the short sum ככ 22 sitting over the middle of the column; the line slopes upward toward the left so its left end (הכוז) is level with VII 13's sum.
P41.facsimile: PDF 695 (pl. CCCLXXII); line 14 left end at fac x 150-390, y 1420-1500; right part (המים) y 1490-1540. loc/P41_facsimile.png = fac box [40,1330,660,1640] at 2x.

A.notes: Facsimile ink registered to the photo (local match, offset about +34,-15). הכוז letters at photo x 230-345, y 1405-1480; VII 15 'בא חפור' directly below; VII 12 left end above; VII 13's ככ at upper right.

B.notes: Same letter sequence as A at the left end (ה-box, ו, ז), with 'בא חפ' on the row below and VII 12 above; left column edge and cracks visible.

C.notes: Second exposure of the same segment; same row pattern as B (target row between VII 12 left end and VII 15 'בא'), shifted about +20 px.

D.notes: Mapped by template match photo=(136,1194)+0.8*(DJD-(420,2050)); stacked comparison shows the same box letters of הכוז, the left-edge crack and the pale lower-left notch, and VII 15 below.

P56.words_on_facsimile: חפור אמות שלוש ככ + unit strokes; the ככ and strokes are at the far left (fac x 60-170, y 925-1000), next to the flake/loss drawn at fac x 140-225, y 935-1020; rivet holes drawn at the left margin above (y 877) and below (y 1037). VIII 8 above ends ...קדרון; VIII 10 below starts בשלף. Line slopes down to the right (fac y ~957 at left, ~990 at x 600).

A.notes: Flake/loss at photo x 215-290, y 925-990 and the two left-margin rivet holes match the facsimile exactly; target row runs between the holes through the flake to שלוש at right.

B.notes: Rivet holes show as white spots (y 904, 1065) = facsimile holes +28 px; the flake shows as a dark hole at x 165-250, y 965-1030 (fac +25,+30). Target row between the holes at the hole's level. Strokes faint.

missing.C: 15C (PDF 669 img 000) and 15D (669 img 001) cover the middle/right of col. VIII (photo x >= ~260 / ~290 after the overexposed edge); the ככ group and strokes (photo x 60-200) are not on them.
missing.D: DJD LXIII: by registration the line falls at the very top of the bottom-left panel (DJD y ~1590-1670, just under the panel gap), but no word shapes could be matched there; possible only.

P63.words_on_facsimile: עשרין וארבע ככ ררר //// : עשרין at fac x 800-940, וארבע 560-760, ככ 430-540, three round numeral signs 200-420, unit strokes 80-200; centre y ~1385-1390, nearly level. VIII 12 above (הצופא צפון חפור אמות) with a rivet hole at its left end; VIII 14 below (בדור של השוא ...).

P92.words_on_facsimile: Counted 11th line from top of col. X: זהב וכלין כפורין עסרין. On the facsimile the vessel word (drawn טפרין/כפורין) is at fac x ~390-560 and the number word at x ~206-390, y ~1014-1076; X 10 above (הי הפתח ככרין שלש מאות, ending ת at x 225-290) and X 12 below (תחת יד אבשלום ...).
